description: The War Powers Act is the law of the land, passed by Congress in the wake of Vietnam to ensure that it played the role laid out for it in the Constitution when it came to matters of war. Should the Trump Administration fail to comply with the Act's requirements within the next 24 hours (the 60 day mark of the Iran conflict), it will have expanded its disregard for the rule of law into a whole new venue - one where the Founders clearly wanted Congress to have the lead.By all indications, Republi
